text: Brent closed at 92.14 USD/bbl on 11 November, up 2.2% from 90.16 USD/bbl the previous day, and is 0.3% higher over the past week. The 1-month change is -29.1%, with prices ranging between 90.16 and 129.95 USD/bbl. In Egypt, the bid deadline for the 14-block EGAS and EGPC rounds was extended to 14 December on 1 November.
